title: Jumbo Versus the Police
question: Why did the police have to push Jumbo off the main street?

meanings.usage: 指进行马戏表演的团体或场所
名词，表示赠送给他人的东西
医疗机构，用于治疗和护理病人
表示与某人一起做某事
表示向某人或某物走去
表示不愿意做某事或接受某事
指道路上的车辆和行人流动
表示有好运气或有利的情况
法律术语，指依法拘捕嫌疑人
表示某物的重量或测量重量
表示责任或义务，也可表示建议
表示用力量使物体移动
表示保护或看守的人员
表示过去的经历或表现的记载
表示给予许可或允许做某事

examples.en: The children dressed up as pirates for Halloween.
examples.zh: 孩子们在万圣节装扮成海盗。

examples.en: They set off for the mountains early in the morning.
examples.zh: 他们一大早就出发去山区了。

examples.en: The accident held up traffic for two hours.
examples.zh: 事故使交通堵塞了两个小时。

phrases.usage: 过去应该做但实际未做（虚拟语气）

examples.en: You ought to have told me the truth.
examples.zh: 你早该告诉我真相的。

phrases.usage: 放过某人，不追究某人的责任

examples.en: The police let him off with a warning.
examples.zh: 警察只是警告了一下就放过了他。

examples.en: He has a good record at school.
examples.zh: 他在学校表现良好。

examples.en: This elephant weighs a few tons.
examples.zh: 这头大象有几吨重。

examples.en: Come here at once!
examples.zh: 立刻到这里来！

examples.en: Go along this road and turn left at the second corner.
examples.zh: 沿着这条路走，在第二个拐角左转。

examples.en: He must be very tired after working all day.
examples.zh: 他工作了一整天肯定很累了。

sentences.en: Last Christmas, the circus owner, Jimmy Gates, decided to take some presents to a children's hospital.
sentences.zh: 去年圣诞节，马戏团老板吉米·盖茨决定给一家儿童医院送些礼物。

sentences.en: Dressed up as Father Christmas and accompanied by a 'guard of honour' of six pretty girls,
sentences.zh: 他打扮成圣诞老人，由六个漂亮女孩组成的“仪仗队”陪同，

sentences.en: he set off down the main street of the city riding a baby elephant called Jumbo.
sentences.zh: 骑着一头名叫Jumbo的小象，沿着城市的主街出发了。

sentences.en: He should have known that the police would never allow this sort of thing.
sentences.zh: 他本该知道警察绝不会允许这种事情发生。

sentences.en: A policeman approached Jimmy and told him he ought to have gone along a side street as Jumbo was holding up the traffic.
sentences.zh: 一名警察走近吉米，告诉他本该走小巷，因为Jumbo正在阻碍交通。

sentences.en: Though Jimmy agreed to go at once, Jumbo refused to move.
sentences.zh: 尽管吉米同意立即离开，但Jumbo却拒绝移动。

sentences.en: Fifteen policemen had to push very hard to get him off the main street.
sentences.zh: 十五名警察不得不非常用力地推，才把他弄下主街。

sentences.en: The police had a difficult time, but they were most amused.
sentences.zh: 警察们费了好大劲，但他们都觉得很有趣。

sentences.en: 'Jumbo must weigh a few tons,' said a policeman afterwards,
sentences.zh: “Jumbo肯定有几吨重，”一名警察事后说，

sentences.en: 'so it was fortunate that we didn't have to carry him.
sentences.zh: “所以我们不必抬他真是幸运。

sentences.en: Of course, we should arrest him, but as he has a good record, we shall let him off this time.'
sentences.zh: 当然，我们应该逮捕他，但鉴于他表现良好，这次我们就放过他了。”

grammar.title: 情态动词 ought to 的用法
grammar.definition: ought to 表示责任、义务或建议，其过去式 ought to have done 表示过去应该做而实际未做，带有责备或遗憾的意味
grammar.structure: ought to + 动词原形 / ought to have + 过去分词
grammar.usage: 用于表达应该做的事情，以及对过去未完成事情的遗憾

examples.en: You ought to be more careful.
examples.zh: 你应该更小心一些。

examples.en: He ought to have known that the police would never allow this.
examples.zh: 他早该知道警察是绝不会允许这种事的。

grammar.title: must 表示推测
grammar.definition: must 用于肯定句中表示对现在情况的推测，意为'一定、肯定'
grammar.usage: 用于对所见所闻进行有把握的推断

examples.en: Jumbo must weigh a few tons.
examples.zh: Jumbo 肯定有好几吨重。

examples.en: She must be at home now.
examples.zh: 她现在肯定在家。

grammar.title: let someone off
grammar.definition: 让某人免受惩罚，放过某人
grammar.usage: 常用于警察或 authorities 对违法者网开一面的情况

examples.en: As he has a good record, we shall let him off this time.
examples.zh: 因为他有良好的记录，我们这次就放过他。

examples.en: The teacher let the student off with a warning.
examples.zh: 老师警告了一下就放过了那个学生。

patterns.pattern: ought to have + 过去分词

original.en: He should have known that the police would never allow this sort of thing.
original.zh: 他早该知道警察是绝不会允许这种事的。

examples.en: You ought to have arrived earlier.
examples.zh: 你早该早点到的。

examples.en: She ought to have finished her homework.
examples.zh: 她早该完成作业的。

patterns.pattern: must + 动词原形（表示推测）

original.en: Jumbo must weigh a few tons.

examples.en: He must be very hungry.
examples.zh: 他肯定很饿。

examples.en: This must cost a lot of money.
examples.zh: 这肯定花了很多钱。

original.en: We shall let him off this time.

examples.en: The judge let her off with a fine.
examples.zh: 法官只罚了点款就放过了她。

examples.en: They let us off the hook.
examples.zh: 他们放过了我们。

original.en: He was riding a baby elephant called Jumbo when a policeman approached.
original.zh: 正当他骑着一头叫Jumbo的小象时，一个警察走了过来。

examples.en: She was reading a book when the phone rang.
examples.zh: 她正在看书时电话响了。

examples.en: I was walking home when it started to rain.
examples.zh: 我正走回家时开始下雨了。
